reportsLibrary.title: Report library
reportsLibrary.sub: Pick a question, see the answer. Pin the numbers you want on Home. Money and the books are in Finance.

cards.profit: Did we make money after all costs?
cards.aov: How big is an average order?

restock.title: Restock now
restock.sub: Styles that sold in the last 30 days and a size is out or the stock is running short.
restock.unsoldSub: In stock, old enough and nothing sold in the last 30 days.

time.title: When orders come in
time.sub: Orders by weekday and by hour of the day, in the shop's time, for the period above.

review.title: Monthly review
review.sub: Last month ({from} to {to}) in a few lines, from the numbers. Nothing is guessed.
review.sales: Sales were {amount}, {pct}% {dir} than the month before.
review.profit: Net profit was {amount}, {pct}% {dir} than the month before.
review.profitUnknown: Net profit is not known yet (the ad spend is missing).
